templates.name: KPI Export / QBR Pipeline
templates.description: Pull KPI data from the ALIS export API, benchmark against ALIS 500, pull HubSpot ticket history, and generate QBR discussion-point flags

companyHost.title: ALIS Company Host (subdomain)
companyHost.description: The subdomain root of this company's ALIS admin URL (e.g. "viva" for viva.alisonline.com) — used to build the export API auth username. If this account spans more than one ALIS host (e.g. after a portfolio merge), comma-separate them (e.g. "viva, viva-secondary") — data from every host is pulled and combined into one QBR.

communities.title: Communities (optional)
communities.description: Leave empty to automatically pull every community from every configured host, excluding any with "Training" in the name

host.title: ALIS Host (optional)
host.description: Only needed for a multi-host account — which of the comma-separated Company Hosts above this community belongs to. Defaults to the first host if omitted.

hubspotCompanyId.title: HubSpot Company ID (optional)
hubspotCompanyId.description: Links this KPI pull to the account's HubSpot ticket history for Support Review / Enhancement Requests

templates.name: Weekly Wellness Scorecard
templates.description: Pull clinical-risk indicators (falls, elopement, behavioral incidents, med exceptions, overdue evaluations, staff compliance) for the past week, broken out by AL/MC and community, with trend vs. prior week and ALIS 500 benchmark comparison where published

companyHost.title: ALIS Company Host (subdomain)
companyHost.description: The subdomain root of this company's ALIS admin URL (e.g. "imagineseniorliving" for imagineseniorliving.alisonline.com). Comma-separate multiple hosts for a multi-host account.

communities.title: Communities (optional)
communities.description: Leave empty to automatically pull every community from every configured host, excluding any with "Training" in the name

host.title: ALIS Host (optional)
host.description: Only needed for a multi-host account — defaults to the first host if omitted.

weekEnding.title: Week Ending (YYYY-MM-DD)
weekEnding.description: The last day of the 7-day window this report covers (e.g. the most recent Sunday)

templates.name: Company/Community ALIS Usage Audit
templates.description: For a company (and optionally its communities), compare what was Contracted (HubSpot deal line items), what's Enabled (ALIS Entitlements page), and what's actually Used (ALIS export API activity) feature-by-feature — a visual RAG grid replacing the old manually-maintained roadmap spreadsheet

companyHost.title: ALIS Company Host(s) (subdomain)
companyHost.description: The subdomain root of this company's ALIS admin URL (e.g. "imagineseniorliving" for imagineseniorliving.alisonline.com). Comma-separate multiple hosts if this company has communities split across more than one ALIS account/URL — communities from every host are compared side by side in one grid.

alisAdminCompanyIds.title: ALIS Admin Company ID(s) (optional)
alisAdminCompanyIds.description: The numeric company ID from admin.alisonline.com/Customers/EntitlementSets/EditCompany/{id} for each host above, in the SAME ORDER as ALIS Company Host(s) — e.g. "353" or "353,412" for two hosts. Leave a position blank ("353,") to skip the Entitlements scrape for that host. Leave the whole field empty to skip Enabled entirely.

hubspotCompanyId.title: HubSpot Company ID (optional)
hubspotCompanyId.description: Leave empty to skip the Contracted column entirely.

communities.title: Communities (optional)
communities.description: Leave empty to automatically pull every non-training, non-canceled community from every configured host

name.title: Community Name
examples: The Gardens at Lake Wellington Assisted Living

host.title: ALIS Host (optional)
host.description: Only needed for a multi-host account — defaults to the first host if omitted.

lookbackDays.title: Usage Lookback Window (days)
lookbackDays.description: How far back to check for real activity (billing, med administration, care tracking, evaluations, staff compliance, observations) when determining whether a feature is actually Used, not just Enabled.
